I definitely noticed that my skin felt more hydrated and looked healthy after using it. However, I'm still on the fence about whether it's truly worth the price point. If you already love Drunk Elephant and don't mind investing in higher-end skincare, I think it's worth trying. But in my opinion, you can achieve very similar hydration results with more affordable products on the market. Overall, I'm glad I gave it a shot!
